quest.title: Mondstadt and its Archon
quest.description: Now that Mondstadt has been spared from disaster, Sister Grace would like to offer her thanks to the Anemo Archon for its protection of the city.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x16000, Hero's Wit x5, Dandelion Seed x5

talks.objective: Give the Dandelion Seeds to Grace

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Have you gathered the Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: These should be enough. Please wait here for a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, she's so... devout. So... many words...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knows if that Tone-Deaf Bard is listening...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Alright. Please take these dandelions seeds. Help me go up and scatter them.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I should really do this myself, but with my physical abilities... I would probably have a hard time getting back down, even if I could climb up there.

talks.objective: Climb to the Anemo Archon statue's hand and scatter the Dandelion Seeds

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Have you scattered the Dandelion Seeds?

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Regardless, I do hope that Lord Barbatos will be able to hear my voice.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Thank you for your willingness to help. Please take this for your troubles — and may the Anemo Archon protect you.

choices.text: The wind will carry them far abroad.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: That's wonderful. It should be easy for Lord Barbatos to notice.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos, I hope that you can hear me...
